title: Fix timing-flaky git_history refocus debounce test
body: git_history::changes::tests::refocus_rereads_keeps_selection_and_clicks_open_the_diff (src/git_history/changes.rs) failed 1 of 5 loaded full-suite runs at the final assert (view.request.is_none()). Likely cause, unverified: the 'quick refocus inside the debounce' check relies on the wall clock. If settle() (a real git read) plus frames take over REFOCUS_DEBOUNCE (1s) under load, the refocus is past the debounce and correctly starts a re-read. Confirm, then pin 'started' (or inject the clock) right before that check rather than widening the debounce.
